_comment: Hand-entered 2026 Zimmer draft order. Zimmer (ESPN) has no live draft-order sync of any kind -- Sean reports the order directly and this file is updated by hand, same pattern as miami_draft_order.json / miami_roster_snapshot_2025.json's confirmed_keepers block. Team names must match leagues.zimmer.teams[].team in bigboard.json exactly (Zimmer has no separate manager identity -- that field just duplicates the team name), or convert_bigboard.py will flag them as unmatched instead of guessing.
manager_note: Sean reported this order using casual nicknames/renamed labels rather than the exact bigboard.json team names.
